evidence.title: My mother & Claude. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: My mother & Claude
summary: Paid post that teaches a complete beginner how to use Claude, framed as lessons for the author's retired mother.
description: An instalment of the How to AI newsletter that explains Claude to non-technical people, using the author's retired pharmacist mother as the test case: is it just Google, writing a first prompt, using it for more than answers, dealing with hallucinations, when to open it, and how the author uses it. The full text is for paid subscribers.
